lessons.title: Hello!

items.example: E você? Qual é o seu nome?
items.exampleMeaning: And you? What is your name?
Nice to meet you! It's a pleasure to meet you.
Is everything okay? Are you happy?

lessons.tip: In Portuguese, the verb 'to be' changes depending on the subject. For example, 'Eu sou' means 'I am'. Remember to use the correct pronoun with the verb!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: E você? De onde você é?
dialogue.meaning: And you? Where are you from?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Nice to meet you! Is everything okay?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: Nice to meet you! Everything is okay, thank you.

scenario.partnerRole: You are a friendly person meeting someone new.
scenario.brief: Start by greeting the person. Ask their name and where they are from. Respond to their questions.
scenario.goal: You should introduce yourself and ask the other person's name.

lessons.title: Where Are You From?

items.example: Sim! Eu sou de Minas Gerais.
items.exampleMeaning: Yes! I am from Minas Gerais.

items.example: Eu moro no Rio de Janeiro.
items.exampleMeaning: I live in Rio de Janeiro.

lessons.tip: Use 'Você é de...?' to ask where someone is from. You can answer with 'Eu sou de...' to say your origin.

scenario.partnerRole: You are getting to know someone better.
scenario.learnerRole: You are answering questions about where you are from.
scenario.brief: Ask where the other person is from and share your own city. Confirm if you are Brazilian.
scenario.goal: You should confidently share your city and nationality.

lessons.title: Talking About Yourself
lessons.tip: When describing yourself, use 'Eu sou...' for your profession or traits. For age, use 'Eu tenho... anos.'

scenario.partnerRole: You are discussing personal interests and job.
scenario.brief: Talk about your job and age. Ask about the other person's interests.
scenario.goal: You should share your profession and age.

lessons.title: Wrap Up Your Introduction

items.meaning: It was nice to meet you!
items.exampleMeaning: It was nice to meet you!

lessons.tip: Use 'Até logo!' to say goodbye informally. You can also say 'Tenha um bom dia!' to wish someone well.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: It was nice to meet you!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: It was nice to meet you too!

scenario.partnerRole: You are saying goodbye after meeting someone.
scenario.learnerRole: You are wrapping up the conversation.
scenario.brief: Express that you enjoyed meeting the person and suggest meeting again.
scenario.goal: You should end the conversation politely.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Eu estou bem, obrigado! E você?
dialogue.meaning: I am well, thank you! And you?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Meu nome é Carla. E você?
dialogue.meaning: My name is Carla. And you?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Meu nome é Lucas. Eu sou do Rio de Janeiro.
dialogue.meaning: My name is Lucas. I am from Rio de Janeiro.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, eu gosto de música! Foi bom te conhecer.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, I like music! It was nice to meet you.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Até logo! Nos vemos em breve!
dialogue.meaning: See you later! See you soon!

scenario.partnerRole: You are practicing a full conversation with a new acquaintance.
scenario.learnerRole: You are using all the greetings and introductions learned in this chapter.
scenario.brief: Have a conversation that includes greetings, names, origins, likes, and goodbyes.
scenario.goal: You should demonstrate your ability to introduce yourself and ask questions.
